OPERATOR APPROVAL (2026-09-03, joeoakhart) — Decision B.

Adoption of a "no internal-only compatibility shims" policy is APPROVED. The prerequisite ADR
may proceed through DRAFT -> HOLD -> MERGE citing this approval: it establishes that after a
private symbol moves owners, there is exactly ONE canonical binding; every internal consumer
(source, tests, dynamic/string imports, monkeypatch targets) migrates to it and the old private
binding is deleted. Public facades, MCP wire schemas, event readers, and persisted-data
migrations are EXEMPT and retain their independently specified contracts.

Once the ADR merges, the disjoint migration children may proceed.
